name: ai-suggestions
title: AI Suggestions
description: Prompt suggestion chips for an empty chat or the follow-ups after an answer. They pop in from the middle outward.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: The chips to show, each with an id and a label.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the chip the user picked.

props.name: label
props.description: Small heading above the chips, such as "Follow-ups".

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds between chips as they pop in, counted from the middle outward.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
